import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import gc
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

# Check columns
targets = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
print(f"Training set shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test set shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Text normalization (lowercase)
train_df["comment_text"] = train_df["comment_text"].str.lower()
test_df["comment_text"] = test_df["comment_text"].str.lower()

# Split training data into train/validation (70/30)
train_valid, val = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["toxic"]
)
train = train_valid
val = val

print(f"Train size: {len(train)}, Validation size: {len(val)}")

# Vectorize text with fewer features for faster training
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=5, stop_words="english"
)
train_vectors = vectorizer.fit_transform(train["comment_text"])
val_vectors = vectorizer.transform(val["comment_text"])
test_vectors = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

print(f"Feature matrix shape: {train_vectors.shape}")

# Train models for each target with optimized parameters for speed
models = {}
auc_scores = []
val_predictions = {}

print("Training models...")
for target in targets:
    y_train = train[target].values
    y_val = val[target].values

    # LightGBM parameters optimized for speed and completion
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "n_estimators": 100,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "max_depth": 4,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "early_stopping_rounds": 30,
        "verbose_eval": -1,
    }

    train_data = lgb.Dataset(train_vectors, label=y_train)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(val_vectors, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=150,
        valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(30, verbose=False), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )

    val_pred = model.predict(val_vectors)
    val_predictions[target] = val_pred

    # Calculate ROC AUC
    if len(np.unique(y_val)) > 1:
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
        auc_scores.append(auc)
    else:
        auc = 0.5
        auc_scores.append(0.5)

    models[target] = model
    print(f"Target: {target}, Validation AUC: {auc:.4f}")

# Mean ROC AUC
mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Mean Validation ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate submission
print("Generating submission...")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"]})
for target in targets:
    pred = models[target].predict(test_vectors)
    submission[f"{target}"] = pred

# Save submission
submission_path = f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv"
submission.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
print(f"All targets completed successfully. Mean Validation ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")
